draft.title: Interpreting slope and intercept
card: In a fitted line y = a + bx, y is the response variable and x is the explanatory variable. The slope is b and the intercept is a.
the predicted change in y for each increase of 1 unit in x. If b is negative, y is predicted to fall as x rises.
the predicted value of y when x = 0. It only makes sense if x = 0 is a realistic value for the situation.
Example: cost = 40 + 6 × hours, with cost in dollars and time in hours. Each extra hour adds $6 to the predicted cost. At 0 hours the predicted cost is $40.
draft.remember: Slope: change in y per 1 unit of x. Intercept: predicted y when x is 0.

a.q: A line predicts a plant's height (cm) from days of growth: height = 12 + 3 × days. What does the slope of 3 mean?
opts: Height is predicted to rise by 3 cm each day
Height is predicted to be 3 cm after 12 days
The plant is predicted to be 3 cm tall at the start
Height is predicted to rise by 12 cm every 3 days
a.why: The slope is the change in height for each extra day, so 3 cm per day. The 12 is the intercept, which is the predicted height at 0 days, so the option about the start is the intercept's meaning wrongly given to the slope.
a.clue: The slope is the change in y for each 1 unit of x.

b.q: Leo's data give: phone battery left (%) = 95 − 8 × hours of use. Which statement is correct?
opts: Battery is predicted to fall 8 percentage points per hour
Battery is predicted to be 8% after 95 hours of use
Battery is predicted to rise 8 percentage points per hour
Battery is predicted to fall 95 percentage points per hour
b.why: The slope is −8, so each extra hour of use is predicted to lower the battery by 8 percentage points. The option saying it rises ignores the negative sign. The 95 is the intercept, the predicted battery at 0 hours.
b.clue: Check the sign of the slope, then ask what 1 unit of x is.

a.best: Height is predicted to rise by 3 cm each day

b.best: Battery is predicted to fall 8 percentage points per hour
